doc.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
doc.interviewee: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey

title: Playing with Johnny St. Cyr at the roof-garden opening
summary: The interviewer recalls a photo of the band at the first night under the roof, with Johnny St. Cyr and Frankie Duesen.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You were in that band of Ireland, too, weren't you fast on that? Well, I was on them, I used to play up there. I believe Johnny St. Cyr was in that band. Yeah. I have a picture with you in that band, too. That's right, I was in that. The first night they put the roof over it. They took a picture with a doctor's dance. See, I'll get a copy of that for you sometime.
Yeah, I'd like to see that.
The band's so small, you can hardly see who's in it, but Johnny told me he'd play it out.
Yeah, well we used to work together. Yeah. It was a long time.
We worked with Frankie Duesen a long time. Frank played in the band together with Frankie.
